teams.name: CCS MEN'S TAEKWONDO TEAM
teams.summary: Strike First! Strike Hard! No Mercy!
teams.overview:
The 🥋 CCS Men's Taekwondo Team is composed of dedicated and disciplined student-athletes committed to developing their skills, strength, agility, and competitive spirit. Through rigorous training, perseverance, and teamwork, the team aims to represent the College of Computer Studies with pride and sportsmanship in every competition.

More than just physical strength, the team values discipline, respect, self-control, and determination. Every member is encouraged to push their limits, improve their techniques, and uphold the true spirit of Taekwondo.

teams.name: CCS E-Games MLBB
teams.summary: Play with Strategy. Compete with Passion. Rise as One Phoenix.
teams.overview:
The CCS Phoenix E-Games Team is composed of passionate and competitive student gamers who represent the College of Computer Studies in esports competitions. United by their love for gaming, strategic thinking, and teamwork, the team strives to showcase their skills, coordination, and determination in every match.

Beyond individual talent, the team values communication, discipline, adaptability, and sportsmanship. Whether competing under pressure or working together toward victory, every member plays an important role in bringing pride and recognition to CCS.
